thing: The change from C to A minor, without lifting the whole hand.
notation: C  x32010    Am  x02210     only the ring finger moves: 5th string, 3rd fret -> 3rd string, 2nd fret
feel: index and middle fingers stay pressed: they are in the same place in both chords
only the ring finger travels, two strings over and one fret back
slow: 60 beats a minute, four strums on each chord, say "C... A minor" on beat one
breaks: a beginner takes all three fingers off and puts them back; the change is slow and the strings buzz
the wrist bends, a finger lies on the 5th string and mutes it
fast and wrong becomes the habit; slow and clean turns into speed by itself in a week

cards.meaning: keep index and middle down, move only the ring finger
C chord: 5th string 3rd fret, 4th 2nd, 2nd 1st; 6th string not played
A minor: 4th string 2nd fret, 3rd 2nd, 2nd 1st; 6th string not played

homework: 2 minutes: hold C, then Am, four strums each, 60 beats a minute
5 minutes: 20 clean changes; count them out loud, start again when one buzzes
8 minutes: play along with any song you know that moves between C and A minor
